name: 93638 · Madera, CA
findings: ZIP 93638 (Madera) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93638 (Madera) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93638 (Madera) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
